patterns.note: Sections alternate between full-bleed dark backgrounds (deep purple/blue) and white backgrounds, with content consistently centered and constrained to a maximum width.

A clear typographic hierarchy is established with large, bold sans-serif headings for impact, supported by smaller, readable sans-serif body text, and occasional uppercase labels for feature descriptions.

A sophisticated brand palette uses a dominant deep purple-blue (#2a206a) as a primary background and brand color, vibrantly contrasted with a bright, energetic green (#3cb982) for calls-to-action and key highlights.

The main navigation bar transforms from a transparent overlay to a compact, opaque sticky bar with a solid dark background as the user scrolls down the page. Content sections reveal with a subtle fade-up or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport.
The homepage features a prominent social proof section displaying client logos (e.g., Uber, Klarna) in a clean, minimalist grid, reinforcing trust and authority.

technique_notes: Scroll-triggered reveals animate sections into view with a subtle fade-up or slide-up effect as they enter the viewport, likely using CSS keyframes. The main navigation transforms from a transparent overlay to a compact, opaque sticky bar with a solid background after initial scroll, adjusting text color for contrast. The initial hero graphic, which appears to be a dynamic 3D-rendered element, is designed to be a prominent visual that gives way to content upon scrolling, potentially leveraging canvas animation for its interactive qualities.

Content is structured within full-width sections that alternate background colors, with all textual and interactive elements contained within a consistent central maximum width for readability and focus. A modular grid system is employed for displaying content cards, ensuring consistent spacing and alignment across various content types.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) provide strong visual impact, complemented by readable sans-serif body text and smaller, often uppercase, labels for emphasis.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounded corners (~4-8px) are applied consistently to buttons, cards, and input fields, contributing to a modern and approachable aesthetic.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy. Generous vertical spacing separates major sections and elements, while content grids maintain a consistent, slightly denser rhythm for efficient information display.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a deep, rich purple-blue as a primary brand color, contrasted with a vibrant, almost neon green accent, creates a sophisticated yet energetic feel. The dynamic, almost 3D-rendered hero graphic that elegantly transitions out on scroll is a memorable touch, setting a high bar for visual engagement beyond a static image.
